scope.task: Narrow IVS-specific implementation contract for an independent adaptation of pinned IDECAMB onto CAMB 2.0.4

finding.target_background: Q = Gamma rho_v, dot(rho_v) = Q, dot(rho_c)+3 H rho_c = -Q
finding.parameter_map: beta = Gamma/H0, so Q = beta H0 rho_v
finding.idecamb_nonmatching_selector: QForm=Hrde is beta H rho_v and is not the target law
finding.vector_contract: Q_v^mu = Q u_c^mu is compatible with the target IVS equations, gives no CDM-frame force and delta rho_v=0 on CDM-comoving synchronous slices; the target visible IVS equations cite Ref. [141] but do not explicitly spell out this covariant vector. Treat it as the independent adaptation closure, not an attributed target-source fact.
finding.reason: For nonzero coupling, IDECAMB's generic CF PPF path retains/evolves effective-DE perturbations, adds their stress to Einstein sources, and includes a clxq feedback in the CDM continuity source. The target IVS contract requires delta rho_v=0 and no DE perturbative stress.

conventions.positive_Q: energy leaves CDM and enters vacuum
conventions.gauge: scalar synchronous gauge comoving with geodesic CDM; theta_c=0 for the regular CDM-frame solution

target_perturbation_equations.vacuum_perturbation_closure: delta rho_v = delta p_v = delta q_v = pi_v = 0

units.Gamma_and_H0: inverse time in the same solver units
units.idecamb_scaled_source: gQ=8 pi G a^3 Q; grhoc_t=8 pi G a^2 rho_c; therefore gQ/grhoc_t=aQ/rho_c

implementation_contract: Retain coupled rho_c(a), rho_v(a), and H(a) in all background, thermodynamics, distances, equality, density outputs, and transfer paths.
Use physical w_v=-1 with the H0rde interaction semantics and target sign.
Dispatch a dedicated geodesic-IVS perturbation branch separately from generic PPF and separately from stock constant-Lambda background handling.
Allocate and evolve no DE PPF/fluid perturbation state for this branch; force all vacuum perturbative stress components to zero in every Einstein source call.
With theta_c=0, evolve delta_c_prime=-h_prime/2 + a Gamma (rho_v/rho_c) delta_c; in CAMB variables verify -k*z maps to -h_prime/2 and gQ/grhoc_t maps to the positive source coefficient.
Preserve standard photon, massless-neutrino, and massive-neutrino perturbation hierarchies and their anisotropic stress.
Keep the vacuum background dynamic; do not set a stock is_cosmological_constant flag if that selects constant rho_v(a).

source_locators.locator: Section II.A, Eqs. (4)-(8): signs, w=-1 background and Q=Gamma rho_x; Section II.B, Eqs. (19)-(20): IVS perturbations; Section II.B text immediately before Eqs. (15)-(18) introduces zero anisotropic stress/no DM-rest-frame momentum transfer for w_x != -1 fluids.

initial_conditions.recommended_independent_choice: CAMB initial_adiabatic for standard species plus the explicit IVS no-vacuum-perturbation closure and theta_c=0.
initial_conditions.ordinary_early_branch: For D=lim(a^3 rho_c)>0, h~a^2; delta_gamma=delta_nu=-2h/3; delta_b=delta_c=-h/2; theta_c=0 at leading order. A=(Gamma/H)(rho_v/rho_c)~a^5.
initial_conditions.strict_adiabatic_tension: For Gamma!=0, beta_v=d ln rho_v/d ln a=Gamma/H=O(a^2); a strict equal-zeta time shift would require delta_v=beta_v*h/6=O(a^4), whereas the target closure imposes delta_v=0. State the closure as an explicit exception, not a derived all-species adiabatic condition.
initial_conditions.edge_branch: If D=0 and Gamma<0, the displayed Eq. (19) has A->-5 and regular delta_c=-h/7; conventional equal-zeta initial data would demand +h/3. This is an unresolved edge-branch ambiguity; require global rho_c>0 and do not silently choose an IC. At D=0,Gamma=0, delta_c is undefined.

regression_checks_to_run_later: Both signs of beta: background conservation, rho_v>0, rho_c>0, H^2>0 from radiation era to today; compare ODE to independent integral identities.
Beta=0 exact recovery of stock CAMB background, densities, transfers, and spectra at declared precision.
Fixed-metric perturbation source equals Eq. (19) for beta=0 and both signs; verify gQ/grhoc_t=a*Gamma*rho_v/rho_c and theta_c=0 is preserved.
No PPF/vacuum stress reaches dgrho, dgq, or dgpi for the IVS branch; toggling generic PPF cannot alter IVS results.
Standard photon/neutrino hierarchy and nonzero neutrino shear are retained.
Check convergence in background/perturbation accuracy; audit equality, r_drag, transfers, lensing, and explicitly defined baryon+CDM or CDM-only growth.

independent_algebra_crosscheck.method: Manual symbolic/unit cross-check using target Eqs. (4)-(8),(19)-(20) and IDECAMB source definitions; no archive code executed.
independent_algebra_crosscheck.identity_1: Gamma=beta*H0 makes Q=Gamma*rho_v identical to beta*H0*rho_v.
independent_algebra_crosscheck.identity_3: For T_v=-rho_v*g and Q_v^mu=Q*u_c^mu, the time projection yields dot(rho_v)=Q, CDM receives -Q, and the orthogonal projection gives zero CDM force plus homogeneous rho_v on CDM-orthogonal synchronous slices.
independent_algebra_crosscheck.identity_4: The IDECAMB uc mapping sets gD1=0 (no CDM-frame force) but does not turn off PPF dgrhoe; its w=-1 branch includes gQ*vT/k, so uc is not by itself the target IVS closure.
